mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET_AUTH ( USER_ID, EMAIL, AUTH_CODE, AUTH_TYPE, VERIFIED_YN, EXPIRE_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{email}, #{authCode}, #{authType}, 'N', #{expireAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PASSWORD_RESET_AUTH WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND AUTH_TYPE = #{authType} AND VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND EXPIRE_AT >= NOW() ORDER BY AUTH_ID DESC LIMIT 1
